prompt652_rationale: A long-running soak exercises daemon stability over time and requires live daemon runtime. The daemon's bounded execution + self-healing were already accepted live (prompt644a), and soak is hardening rather than a prerequisite for proving project-level orchestration. The genuine remaining gap toward FULL unattended autonomy is the live auto-execution bridge (controller -> run daemon over the populated queue -> feed REAL results back -> iterate), which requires live Codex/daemon runtime that this offline loop must not run uncontrolled.
prompt652_recommended_followup: An operator-triggered live /tmp prompt that (a) wires run_project_loop to actually run scripts/run_task_queue_daemon.py over the populated explicit queue dir with --max-fix-attempts, (b) feeds real run_reports back into evaluate_project_completion, and (c) optionally a bounded soak; all under the existing strict effect gate and main-repo safety.
